longTitle.officialTitle: To expand the tropical disease product priority review voucher program to encourage treatments for Zika virus.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Adding Zika Virus to the FDA Priority Review Voucher Program Act”.

section.heading: EXPANDING TROPICAL DISEASE PRODUCT PRIORITY REVIEW VOUCHER PROGRAM TO ENCOURAGE TREATMENTS FOR ZIKA VIRUS DISEASE.
section.chapeau: Section 524(a)(3) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act (21 U.S.C. 360n(a)(3)) is amended—

paragraph.content: in subparagraph (Q), by striking “Filoviruses” and inserting “Filovirus Diseases”; and

by inserting after subparagraph (Q) the following:
“(R) Zika Virus Disease.” .
